_doc.description: Per-material-class safety factors for sim margin verdicts.
_doc.source: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., §6 (fatigue) and §2 (static); AISC LRFD Table B4.1 (structural); ASME VIII-1 §UG-23 (pressure).

fields.sf_yield: Static design safety factor on yield strength (max_stress × sf_yield ≤ yield_mpa).
fields.sf_endurance: Fatigue safety factor on endurance limit (for context where cyclic loading is flagged).
fields.class: Material class name — matched from study material.name by simple keyword heuristic.

verdict_rules.WARN: yield_mpa < max_stress_mpa × sf_yield ≤ ultimate_mpa  (yielded but not fractured)

metal_steel.source: Shigley §6-12 (general machine design); AISC structural steel safety basis.

metal_aluminium.source: Shigley §6-12; aluminium has no true endurance limit so sf_endurance is conservative.

metal_titanium.source: Shigley §6-12; aerospace-grade titanium — tighter SF allowed due to well-characterised fatigue.

polymer.source: Conservative per Shigley §2-1 note on plastics: high scatter, temperature sensitivity, creep.

general.source: Conservative default when material class is unrecognised.
